audit_notes.au:cause: cot-caught merger — cmudict transcribes the THOUGHT set as AA. Why sub:AA/AO ships merger_sensitive and off by default.
audit_notes.a:damage: crosswalk claims the unstressed vowel is /ɪ/; cmudict says AH0 (schwa). A real content question for the crosswalk, not a generator bug.
